title: ModelFootprints
description: Data file content/hardware/models.json (B7 R2): VRAM and load time per AI model, measured through the GPU queue, plus the VRAM the game itself needs. The AI service keeps the loaded models within budget = VRAM of the GPU minus game_vram_mib.

game_vram_mib.description: VRAM the running game needs (B2514 T6).

id.description: Model id as the runtime knows it (Ollama tag, ComfyUI workflow name, ...).

role.description: What the model is used for.

runtime.description: ollama = Ollama server; comfyui = ComfyUI server (/free unloads); hook = loaded by a handler inside the service (e.g. MOSS for sound, B8).

vram_mib.description: VRAM to reserve while loaded (peak/reserved, not average).

measured.description: true = measured on the reference PC; false = placeholder until B7 S3.

source.description: Where the value comes from (AMW document, run), or null.

never_with.description: Model ids that must not be loaded at the same time, whatever the budget says.
